text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The whole world is a straight line, the whole world is a straight line...
—Alright.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
They say the power of belief has a genuine effect on the body.
Right now, there is nothing I fear.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: After all, the entire world looks like a straight line to me.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Trainer,
your face looks rather square today.
choice_data_list: I wonder if that's really okay?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
There is no hindrance to my running. Above all else...
in the world of straightaways, I do not lose.
